data_quality.notes: Priority airline gold pass refreshed against Air France extra/overweight/oversize baggage, Flying Blue, seat, infant, and Kids Solo sources. Key model: fare/cabin allowance plus online-vs-airport option timing and Flying Blue tier.

fees.conditions: Cabin allowance depends on fare and cabin; Basic may include only a small underseat bag unless hand baggage option is added

data_quality.notes: Air France Basic is the key carry-on exception: the Hand Baggage option can be purchased up to 4 hours before departure.

fees.conditions: Basic fare Hand Baggage option; price shown during purchase or in My Bookings; purchasable up to 4 hours before departure.
Additional checked bag price is shown during booking/My Bookings; online discount may apply if bought 24h+ early
fees.applies_to: All fares (where additional bags are permitted)
fees.timing: at booking / manage booking / online check-in

data_quality.notes: Air France prices additional baggage by itinerary and timing. Canada/U.S. routes are an exception where online and airport price can be the same.

fees.conditions: Oversized option applies over 158 cm up to 300 cm; airport-only price depends on itinerary
Overweight option applies above included allowance up to 32 kg; airport-only price depends on itinerary

fees.amount: Depends on route, fare, and seat type
fees.conditions: Advance seat price varies by destination, dates, and fare. Economy Light has paid seats until check-in closes; otherwise auto-assigned.
Standard seats are free for Flying Blue Silver/Gold/Platinum, reduced-mobility passengers, unaccompanied children, and Flex fares.
Flying Blue Silver, Gold, and Platinum members receive standard seat selection benefits on eligible Air France flights
Flying Blue Silver/Gold/Platinum get 1 extra checked item; Platinum can get up to 2 on Air France/KLM
fees.region_or_route: SkyTeam flights; higher Platinum benefit on Air France and KLM

data_quality.notes: Flying Blue baggage benefit is tier and operating-carrier dependent and adds to the ticket’s standard allowance.

fees.conditions: Sports equipment can have item-specific rates and is excluded from the normal Additional Baggage option

data_quality.notes: Additional Baggage Option terms exclude sports equipment because sports gear can have a specific rate.

fees.conditions: Lap infants may bring 1 cabin bag and, unless fare excludes checked bags, 1 checked bag up to 10 kg

data_quality.notes: Air France also allows one stroller or framed infant carrier and one car seat in the hold free of charge.

fees.conditions: Change and cancellation terms depend on the fare conditions of the ticket; fare difference may apply
